title: Find affected units
responsibility: Finds everything that may be affected by a change, using dependencies before and after the change.

inputs.name: kernelClosure.input
inputs.description: The dependency graphs before and after a change, changed or uncertain units, and the tests or scenarios that can verify them. Each edge means the first node depends on the second.

outputs.name: affectedUnits
outputs.description: Affected units and their fewest dependency steps from a changed or uncertain unit. Also lists changed units with no covering test, and changed units absent from both graphs.
